register.labelZh: GET BACK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GET BACK Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: get back 可以表示回家或返回某地;get back into something 則可以表示重新開始興趣、工作或日常活動。；get back to somebody 適合用來表示稍後回覆;get back to something 則可以表示回到之前的話題或工作。；get back、get back to 和 get back into 看起來相似,但所描述的情況並不相同。；get back together 可以描述情侶復合;get back at somebody 則可以描述因對方之前做過的事情而報復。
register.summaryEn: Get back can describe returning home or arriving at a place again. Get back into something can describe returning to a hobby, job or regular activity. Get back to somebody is useful when you need time before replying. Get back to something helps you return to an earlier subject or task. Get back, get back to and get back into look similar, but they describe different situations. Get back together describes a couple restarting a relationship. Get back at somebody describes doing something in return for an earlier wrong.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Get back to somebody means to reply to or contact a person.
